course.title: Sass — From Foundations to Professional Design Systems
course.description: A visual-first Dart Sass and SCSS course covering the complete 169-topic, 19-module syllabus, from first compilation through module architecture, design tokens, testing, performance, legacy migration, and professional stylesheet systems.
course.version_scope: Dart Sass and SCSS-first. Official Sass documentation checked on 2026-10-17 and displayed Dart Sass 1.105.2 at that time. Prefer @use/@forward and namespaced sass: modules; use old syntax only in migration contexts.
audience: beginners who know basic HTML and CSS
prerequisites: CSS selectors, properties, values, declarations, box model, layout, and responsive fundamentals.
Basic terminal usage is helpful. Node.js/npm and JavaScript help for tooling integration but are not required for beginner lessons.
learning_outcomes: Explain how Sass extends CSS and how source files compile to browser-ready stylesheets.
Use SCSS variables, values, selectors, interpolation, operators, built-in modules, control flow, mixins, and custom functions.
Structure Sass code with @use and @forward, configurable public APIs, design tokens, and theme systems.
Integrate Dart Sass into reproducible build workflows and validate generated CSS, accessibility, output size, and deprecation warnings.
Refactor legacy Sass safely and build a documented, reusable stylesheet architecture.

learning_roadmap.title: Understand Sass
learning_roadmap.focus: What Sass does, setup, compilation, SCSS syntax.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Compile a small stylesheet and connect the generated CSS to a plain HTML page.

learning_roadmap.title: Learn the core language
learning_roadmap.focus: Selectors, nesting, variables, values, operators, interpolation.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Rebuild a small page stylesheet with named values and restrained nesting.

learning_roadmap.title: Learn reusable Sass features
learning_roadmap.focus: Built-in modules, control flow, mixins, custom functions and diagnostics.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Generate a small spacing scale and reusable component variants from data.

learning_roadmap.title: Learn modular architecture
learning_roadmap.focus: @use, @forward, public APIs, responsive CSS, theming, design tokens.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Refactor a large stylesheet into modules and build a themeable component set.

learning_roadmap.title: Apply Sass to projects
learning_roadmap.focus: Themes, components, responsive behavior, debugging, testing, accessibility.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Build and test a responsive dashboard with keyboard focus and theme coverage.

learning_roadmap.title: Learn production workflows
learning_roadmap.focus: CLI, build integration, source maps, QA, CSS output review, migration.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Create a repeatable validation pipeline and safely modernize legacy code.

learning_roadmap.title: Complete the capstone
learning_roadmap.focus: Use the full course in a production-minded, reusable design system.
learning_roadmap.milestone: Document a modular token/component system with compilation, browser and accessibility evidence.

notes: The 169 numbered lesson titles and subtopics are preserved from the supplied PDF. The course uses CodeLeaf-compatible content files and remains draft pending subject-matter and practical review.
